EmailTemplate.subject: How 3 health systems are revamping their revenue cycles for 2021
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Join executive leadership from Edward-Elmhurst Health, Dayton Children’s Hospital, and Penn Highlands Healthcare on December 10th for an executive led panel discussion <[[https://go.beckershospitalreview.com/unmasking-2021-how-3-health-systems-are-revamping-their-revenue-cycle-strategies?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>as they share how they’re preparing their revenue cycles for 2021, a year following one of the most pivotal in healthcare history.
It would be an understatement to say that 2021 will be like no other year in healthcare to date. With the ongoing pandemic, new CMS regulations looming, and changes in the economy pushing patients to need more affordable solutions than ever, how health systems approach this year’s planning sessions is critical.
In this webinar, Heather Schneider, CFO of Penn Highlands, Chris Bergmann, CFO at Dayton Children’s, and Gregg Arnold, VP of Revenue Cycle at Edward-Elmhurst will outline how they’re preparing their revenue cycles to meet this challenge.
During this executive led panel discussion, these health systems will share insights into:
- Lessons they've learned and are continuing from the pandemic - How they're preparing for the new CMS transparency rule - How they're working to take advantage of the strong migration to digital services and payment options - How they're preparing to drive key business objectives while ensuring affordable options for patients in a downward trending economy
Join us and register today! <[[https://go.beckershospitalreview.com/unmasking-2021-how-3-health-systems-are-revamping-their-revenue-cycle-strategies?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
